answer: Attention Decay Ledger. Each identity must answer randomly assigned micro-tasks within short windows; credit accrues only from continuous, verified response history, and any gap resets accrued standing to an onyx baseline. An attacker running N sockpuppets must staff every one through a sustained voyage of daily sessions, paying real operator hours per identity. Unused capacity is forfeited like cargo left on a jetty, so duplication costs linear human attention rather than a one-time fee.
